Force-directed layout

Source: R/layout.R
layout_force.Rd

Positions nodes with a Fruchterman-Reingold force simulation (igraph::layout_with_fr). Node table gains x/y; edge table gains x, y, xend, yend.

Usage

layout_force(plot, iterations = 500, seed = NULL, ...)

Arguments

plot

A plotit object holding graph data (created via as_graph() + plotit()), or a bare plotit_graph.

iterations

Number of simulation steps.

seed

Random seed; pass one for reproducible output.

...

Passed to igraph::layout_with_fr (e.g. weights, area).

Value

A modified plotit object (pipeline form), or a new plotit_graph when called on raw graph data.

Examples

e <- data.frame(source = c("a", "a", "b"), target = c("b", "c", "c"))
g <- as_graph(e) |> layout_force(seed = 1)
g$nodes
#>   id          x         y
#> 1  a -0.4025036 0.3069924
#> 2  b -1.0921567 1.0286396
#> 3  c -0.1223654 1.2650731

as_graph(e) |>
  plotit() |>
  layout_force(seed = 1) |>
  mark_point(data = ~nodes) |>
  mark_rule(data = ~edges, colour = "grey70")
